summary: This Form 8-K filed by Ares Sports, Media & Entertainment Opportunities LP reports the unregistered sale of limited partnership units across multiple classes for aggregate consideration of approximately $34.2 million, as part of a continuous private offering. The offering is limited to accredited investors and qualified purchasers, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. The filing also discloses the calculation of transactional net asset values (NAV) as of May 31, 2026, used to set transaction prices. No merger, tender offer, or special-situation event is involved.
